dialogues.speaker: Susie
dialogues.text: Have you heard the wind of Windcoming Day?

dialogues.speaker: Susie
dialogues.text: It must be Lord Barbatos who has returned to the homeland with a breeze and has given his blessing to Monddstadt!

dialogues.speaker: Susie
dialogues.text: Lord Barbatos, please enjoy our wine and give your blessing to Mondstadt...
